source.source_text: kiṃ vāsti paramā bhaktiḥ tasyaivārthasya kiṃ phalam | vadāmyasaṃśayaṃ tubhyaṃ pṛcchase tu yathā mama —

T1.close_translation: "[and]-what, indeed, [is]-there-the-supreme-devotion, [and]-of-that-very-aim-what-the-fruit (*?)? I-will-tell-without-doubt-to-you, [and]-you-ask, indeed, [and]-as-mine (*?):" "[Bhairava:] I-ask-the-supreme, O-Devī, by-the-power-of-the-own-reflexive-apprehension (sva-vimarśa-bala), indeed: [and]-the-foremost, indeed, [and]-the-supreme-of-the-goddess (*?), the-capable-of-making-the-dissolution (*?): [and]-all, indeed, *-the-great-fortunes (*?), by-their-own-will (svecchayā), the-all-world-devouring (viśva-bhakṣikā): [and]-yet-the-heart-gone (*?), [and]-their-question (*?), [and]-there-is, O-great-...(*?) [X: "mahādhipe"]:"
